leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a typed useRef hook with a specific DOM element type
Apply TypeScript generics to define the reference target type
Bind the typed useRef instance to a JSX element via the ref attribute
Manipulate DOM properties safely using the typed current property
Configure a useRef to store mutable values with explicit type annotations
Control component behavior by integrating typed refs with event handlers
Construct a React component that utilizes typed references for form inputs
